- [USER] User expressed interest in starting with the Snake Plant and asked for care tips.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided care tips for Snake Plant: 1. Watering: Water only when the top 2-3 inches of soil are dry; overwatering can cause root rot. 2. Sunlight: Tolerates low light but thrives in bright, indirect sunlight. 3. Soil: Requires well-draining soil; ensure pot has drainage holes. 4. Temperature: Prefers 60 - 75°F (15 - 24°C); keep away from drafts. 5. Fertilizer: Use a balanced houseplant fertilizer once a month during growing season. 6. Pruning: Prune back tall leaves to keep tidy. 7. Repotting: Repot every 2-3 years or when outgrowing the pot.
